changes.patient_pages: GET /consultations/me/page in20-item pages with all/upcoming/past views. Loaded counts are labeled as loaded. changes.clinical_access: Queue, dashboard, escalation and mutation401/403 failures share an immediate denial guard. All clinical panels clear and actions are gated. changes.old_records: Doctor history opens a specific completed consultation via /consultations/{id}/closeout only, including records outside Patient360 recent20. Read-only clinician parser separates current SOAP/summary/revision/author/publication state from the last published patient summary, reusing the patient publication allowlist without weakening it. No patient-only metadata endpoint and no clinical edit action.
changes.expiry: Adds requested_expires_at,expired_at,request_expiry_state and expired status. Reached deadlines show expiry pending until server persistence; no claim that capacity is released. Unknown/review_required requests block fresh accept/reschedule and hide patient cancellation. Open/expiry_pending requested cancellation remains available; scheduled behavior remains. Exact saved reschedule replay is still available after expiry or changed eligibility. Requested cards awaiting expiry/review no longer claim to await acceptance.
